protection_and_identity_audit.script:
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
base='4d7158a023aee00b54e565a57cda953fac3a5b48'
allowed={'c++/README.md','c++/g10-systems-runtime-project.md','c++/g11-robotics.md',
 'c++/g12-cpp-zig-rust.md','c++/learning/README.md','c++/learning/check_docs.py'}
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-rz','--name-only',base]).decode().split('\0')
rows=[]; changed=[]
for name in filter(None,paths):
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+name])
 path=root/name
 same=path.is_file() and path.read_bytes()==before
 rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),'unchanged':same})
 if not same: changed.append(name)
if set(changed)!=allowed: raise SystemExit('unexpected changes: '+repr(changed))
topics=[]; gates=[]
for n,name in [(10,'g10-systems-runtime-project.md'),(11,'g11-robotics.md'),(12,'g12-cpp-zig-rust.md')]:
 old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':c++/'+name]).decode()
 new=(root/'c++'/name).read_text()
 original=set(map(int,re.findall(r'^# (\d+)\.',old,re.M)))
 mapped=list(map(int,re.findall(r'<a id="g'+str(n)+r'-topic-(\d+)">',new)))
 assert set(mapped)==original and len(mapped)==len(original),(n,'topic mapping')
 old_gate=old.split('G'+str(n)+' Final Gate',1)[1]
 old_gate=re.split(r'\n# Part|\n# G10 完成状态',old_gate)[0]
 new_gate=re.search(r'^## \d+\. Final Gate\n(.*?)^## \d+\. Final Gate ·',new,re.S|re.M)[1]
 questions=lambda text:re.findall(r'^\s*\d+\.\s+(.+)',text,re.M)
 assert questions(old_gate)==questions(new_gate),(n,'question identity')
 answers=re.search(r'^## \d+\. Final Gate ·[^\n]+\n(.*?)^## \d+\. 参考资料',new,re.S|re.M)[1]
 assert len(questions(answers))==len(questions(old_gate)),(n,'answers count')
 topics.append({'chapter':n,'original':len(original),'mapped':len(mapped)})
 gates.append({'chapter':n,'questions_preserved':len(questions(old_gate)),
               'reference_answers':len(questions(answers))})
out={'base':base,'tracked_files':len(rows),'changed':changed,
     'unchanged_count':sum(r['unchanged'] for r in rows),
     'files':rows,'topics':topics,'gates':gates,
     'limit':'Identity/completeness checks are not independent technical correctness proof.'}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
